content: To reset a password, open the sign-in page, choose Forgot password, enter the registered email address, and follow the verification link. Never share your password or verification code.
Use a unique password and enable multi-factor authentication when available. Do not share passwords, one-time codes, or recovery links with anyone.
Invoices are available in the Billing section of the account dashboard. Select the relevant transaction and choose Download invoice. Contact support if an invoice is missing.
Submit refund requests through the Billing or Help section. Include the transaction reference, but do not include full payment-card details.
If an account is locked, use the account recovery flow or contact the official support team. Support should verify account ownership without asking for your password.
